instruction.en: Press a button 6 times in quick succession.

hint.en: This is the Z-Wave Lifeline group, it is not recommended to change this.
NanoMote Quad sends basic set command when the key 1 is triggered
NanoMote Quad sends switch multilevel set, multilevel start level change and multilevel stop level change command when the key 1 is triggered.
NanoMote Quad sends basic set command when the key 2 is triggered.
NanoMote Quad sends switch multilevel set, multilevel start level change and multilevel stop level change command when the key 2 is triggered.
NanoMote Quad sends basic set command when the key 3 is triggered.
NanoMote Quad sends switch multilevel set, multilevel start level change and multilevel stop level change command when the key 3 is triggered.
